grid: regular lat/lon (EPSG:4326, plate carree), 0.05 x 0.05 deg, row 0 = 90.0 N edge, col 0 = -180.0 E edge
overpass: VIIRS (NOAA-20, NOAA-21) and MODIS Aqua cross the equator at about 13:30 local solar time on the day side: each longitude is seen near its own early afternoon, so the image is not one instant (UTC time grows westward, about 1 h per 15 deg of longitude); polar night and swath gaps are filled with the Blue Marble (a cloud-free 2004 composite)
